latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Maker Hindi — Create Hindi Videos with AI.

- Create Hindi-narrated videos by uploading video clips or images and describing your desired outcome.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM videos and common image/audio formats up to 500MB.
- Automatic session setup and free credits for new users; seamless onboarding without technical steps.
- 1080p MP4 exports processed in 1-2 minutes via a cloud rendering pipeline.
- Quick edit workflows: Hindi voiceover creation, timeline preview, and simple download.
- Error handling for token, credit, and file issues, with clear user guidance.
- Designed for Hindi content creators who want fast, no-fuss video creation with AI narration.
